_comment: 露脸模式规则：① 每个角色一条不同的 face token（≥60 字，逐字节复用）；② 同一角色的所有镜头都照抄它；③ 不同角色的 token 不许雷同。改完跑：python3 production/face_cast.py check-prompts --project production/unterweger
_casting_note: 六个角色都是符合年代的虚构匿名人物（AI 生成），不是任何真实人物的容貌还原：主角不是杰克·翁特维格本人的脸，刑警/警探/记者/编辑/主持人都不是真实个人的肖像。受害者不以任何人像出现，也不给可辨识面容；片中不出现遗体、血腥与作案过程。

characters.name: 作家（本案核心人物 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: an anonymous Austrian man of thirty-nine: a long narrow face with a high forehead and a sharply receding hairline, deep-set grey-blue eyes under heavy hooded lids, thin arched eyebrows, a long straight nose with a slightly hooked bridge, narrow lips with a sardonic upward curl at the left corner, short dark blond hair brushed back and thinning at the crown, pale weathered skin with faint marks on the right cheek; he wears a dark green corduroy jacket over a black turtleneck.

characters.name: 女记者（奥地利电视台 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: a female television reporter, an anonymous Austrian woman of thirty-four, with shoulder-length dark brown hair tucked behind both ears and a blunt fringe: a heart-shaped face with high cheekbones and a pointed chin, wide alert hazel eyes with straight dark lashes, level dark eyebrows, a short straight nose, a wide expressive mouth, warm olive skin; she wears small round glasses, a mustard-yellow blouse and a brown tweed blazer.

characters.name: 出版社老编辑（文学界请愿者 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: a veteran publishing editor, an anonymous Austrian man of sixty-two, thick silver hair combed back over the ears and no beard except a grey moustache: a broad square face with heavy jowls and a deeply lined forehead, small kindly eyes behind thick horn-rimmed spectacles, heavy white eyebrows, a large fleshy nose, a full mouth under the moustache, mottled ruddy skin; he wears a charcoal waistcoat over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up.

characters.name: 维也纳刑警（连环失踪案办案人 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: a criminal investigator, an anonymous Austrian man of fifty-four, short iron-grey hair cropped close at the sides and clean-shaven: a long weathered face with hollow cheeks and a heavy prominent chin, tired deep-set eyes with sagging lower lids, sparse grey eyebrows, a long thin nose with a slightly broken bridge, a thin mouth pressed tight, leathery sun-darkened skin; he wears a rumpled grey herringbone overcoat over a dark tie and dark trousers.

characters.name: 洛杉矶女警探（跨洲并案的另一端 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: a homicide detective, an anonymous American woman of forty-one, straight shoulder-length auburn hair pulled back into a low twist: a square-jawed face with a strong chin and faint freckles across the nose, steady pale blue eyes with fine crow's feet, sandy eyebrows bleached lighter by the sun, a small upturned nose, a wide mouth with chapped lips, sun-flushed fair skin; she wears an open dark navy blazer over a white shirt.

characters.name: 夜场女招待（维也纳夜里的目击者 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: a night-shift bar waitress, an anonymous young woman of twenty-seven, long wavy black hair falling loose over one shoulder: a round soft face with full cheeks and a small chin, large dark brown eyes with thick lashes and a weary gaze, softly arched eyebrows, a small flat nose, a small mouth painted dark red, pale powder-dry skin; she wears a plain black sleeveless dress with a thin silver necklace.
